description: Attribute an item to a trail. Record that an error, alert or bug was caused by the trail after it merged. Errors carry no release or commit SHA, so attribution is a judgement: compare the stack frames and the error's subject against each candidate trail's changed files (`trails get --files`) and resources,…

confidence.description: How sure an attribution is. `high` and `medium` attach the item to the trail; `low` records a suspect for a person to confirm or reject.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence: a stack frame in a changed file, the failing call touching a resource of the trail, or a guard metric of the trail.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

item.description: The error, alert or bug to attribute (number or id).

name: trails_attribute
